# Run the linear regression by GROUP

To investigate the relationship between movement time and task difficulty, we fit one
linear regression for each group. The dependent variable is movement time (`MT`) and the
predictor is the index of difficulty (`ID`).

The regression is performed on the participant-level means created in the previous section.
This avoids treating the repeated movements of one participant as independent
observations

## Prepare the data

`ID` is a categorical variable with values `ID1` and `ID2`. We create a numeric version
for the regression, where `ID1` becomes 1 and `ID2` becomes 2.

```{r}

#| label: regression-data

mt_regression <- mt |>
  mutate(
    ID_numeric = as.numeric(sub("ID", "", ID))
  )

mt_regression
```
